fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name as in government service records. NPS for government employees: 10% of basic+DA deducted from salary, government contributes 14%.
fields.instruction_hi: Sarkari seva records mein darz poora naam likhein. Sarkari karamchariyon ke liye NPS: basic+DA ka 10% salary se kata jaata hai, sarkar 14% ka yogdan deti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your government employee ID number. This is used to link your NPS account with your salary account for automatic contribution deduction.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna sarkari karamchari ID number likhein. Isse aapka NPS account aapke salary account se link kiya jaata hai automatic yogdan katautti ke liye.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the name of your Ministry or Department. This determines your Nodal Officer who processes NPS contributions and manages your PRAN.
fields.instruction_hi: Apne Mantralaya ya Vibhag ka naam likhein. Isse aapke Nodal Officer ka pata chalta hai jo NPS yogdan process karta hai aur aapka PRAN manage karta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your government service joining date. NPS applies to all central government employees joining on or after January 1, 2004.
fields.instruction_hi: Sarkari seva mein joining tithi likhein. NPS un sabhi kendriya sarkari karamchariyon par laagu hota hai jo 1 January 2004 ko ya uske baad joined hain.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number for PRAN generation and KYC verification.
fields.instruction_hi: PRAN generation aur KYC verification ke liye 12 ank ka Aadhaar number likhein.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your salary bank account number for NPS contribution deduction.
fields.instruction_hi: NPS yogdan katautti ke liye apna salary bank khata number likhein.
